title: Cirsium greimleri: a new species of thistle endemic to the Eastern Alps and Dinarides
principal_inference: Separated diploid C. greimleri from tetraploid C. waldsteinii and documented allopatric/polyploid differentiation.
known_limit: regional pair rather than a broad species tree
EAzami_relevance: clear precedent that cytotype and population sampling can change species limits and trait-history coding

title: Cirsium sect. Cirsium in Turkey: a taxonomic revision
sampling: 17 species and 27 taxa in section Cirsium within a 66-species Turkish flora
principal_inference: Revised names and distributions and recorded two additional natural hybrids.
known_limit: no molecular phylogeny; regional morphology-based treatment
EAzami_relevance: important synonym/hybrid checklist for western Palearctic tip harmonization
data_or_access: open Turkish Journal of Botany article

title: Cirsium paludigenum and C. zhejiangense are synonymous with C. sieboldii and C. yezoense
sampling: Chinese type material and Japanese species concepts
principal_inference: Extended C. sieboldii and C. yezoense concepts into Zhejiang by synonymizing two Chinese names.
known_limit: does not provide a population nuclear tree
EAzami_relevance: critical accepted-name bridge for Japan-China sampling and for avoiding false nuclear gaps

title: Cirsium lipskyi is reinstated for C. interpositum and C. chrysolepis is a synonym of C. nishiokae
principal_inference: Reinstated and synonymized names that affect Chinese tip matching.
EAzami_relevance: prevents accepted-name mismatches when recovering Moreyra/GenBank tips

title: Lamyropsis macracantha is a Cirsium based on morphology and nuclear ITS/ETS sequence data
sampling: focal Lamyropsis macracantha plus comparative Cardueae sequences
principal_inference: Transferred the focal species to Cirsium and tested its generic placement with nuclear ribosomal evidence.
known_limit: two linked ribosomal regions and limited focal sampling
EAzami_relevance: relevant to Chinese taxon scope and alternative generic-name harmonization

title: Reinstatement of Cirsium belingschanicum as distinct from C. japonicum
principal_inference: Reinstated a species previously treated within the broad C. japonicum concept.
EAzami_relevance: important for defining continental Sinocirsium sampling and avoiding over-lumping

title: Cirsium medogense: a new species supported by morphological and molecular data
sampling: new species plus accessions of C. lipskyi and C. eriophoroides
principal_inference: Placed C. medogense in sect. Epitrachys as sister to C. lipskyi accessions in a supported local clade.
known_limit: four loci and narrow local taxon set; not a regional phylogenomic backbone
EAzami_relevance: adds a recent Chinese nuclear/plastid placement and exposes remaining sect. Epitrachys sampling gaps

title: Karyotype analysis and chromosome number for two Cirsium taxa in Iran
sampling: multiple populations of C. ciliatum subsp. szovitsii and C. echinus
principal_inference: Both taxa were diploid 2n=34 and carried B chromosomes with population-level karyotype variation.
known_limit: two taxa and no sequence phylogeny
EAzami_relevance: extends evidence that cytotype/B-chromosome metadata are required outside East Asia as well

title: Cirsium x giresunicum: a new hybrid from Turkey
sampling: hybrid between C. poluninii and C. trachylepis with parental comparisons
principal_inference: Reported a morphologically and molecularly intermediate natural hybrid in sect. Epitrachys.
known_limit: single local hybrid and ribosomal marker only
EAzami_relevance: adds western Asian evidence that trait intermediacy and reticulation cross sectional boundaries

title: Cirsium x ovitense: a new hybrid from Turkey
sampling: hybrid individuals between C. macrobotrys and C. vulgare with parental comparisons
principal_inference: Supported a natural hybrid with ITS polymorphism and intermediate morphology/pollen.
known_limit: single local hybrid and no genome-wide ancestry
EAzami_relevance: reinforces that widespread C. vulgare and regional lineages can exchange ancestry

title: A target enrichment method for gathering phylogenetic information from hundreds of loci: An example from the Compositae
markers_or_loci: conserved ortholog probes; 763 recovered nuclear loci
principal_inference: Established the original reusable Compositae nuclear target-enrichment framework and recovered expected family relationships from hundreds of loci.
known_limit: method demonstration with sparse taxon sampling rather than a Cirsium tree
EAzami_relevance: technical origin of the locus framework later expanded and reused for Cardueae and Cirsium
data_or_access: open article; Dryad alignments and 763-locus Newick

title: A fully resolved backbone phylogeny reveals numerous dispersals and explosive diversifications throughout the history of Asteraceae
principal_inference: Resolved the family backbone and major dispersal/diversification history with dense nuclear genomic sampling.
known_limit: family-scale sampling is too sparse within Cardueae and Cirsium for focal transition inference
EAzami_relevance: provides the higher-level placement and methodological continuity of Compositae target capture
data_or_access: open article and Smithsonian repository PDF

title: Species Diversification of Genus Cirsium (Asteraceae) in Japan
sampling: Japanese Cirsium diversity and endemic radiation
principal_inference: Outlined the exceptional Japanese diversity and an infrageneric interpretation preceding modern phylogenomics.
known_limit: not a molecular species tree and uses historical taxon concepts
EAzami_relevance: essential historical hypothesis and nomenclatural baseline to compare with Moreyra 2025
data_or_access: open Korean Journal of Plant Taxonomy PDF

title: Cirsium tatakaense (Compositae), a new species from Taiwan
sampling: central-southern Taiwan material with comparison to C. kawakamii
principal_inference: Described a purplish-red-flowered tetraploid taxon with 2n=64 distinct from white-flowered C. kawakamii.
known_limit: no multilocus nuclear placement in the original description
EAzami_relevance: provides the original phenotype/cytotype contrast later embedded in the Nipponocirsium phylotranscriptomic framework
data_or_access: open PhytoKeys article; type and locality data

title: Cirsium taiwanense (Compositae, Cirsium sect. Onotrophe, subsect. Australicirsium), a new species from Taiwan
sampling: Taiwanese populations compared with allied taxa
principal_inference: Recognized a yellow-flowered dysploid species with 2n=32 and provided a revised key to Taiwanese Cirsium.
known_limit: no modern multilocus nuclear species-tree analysis in the paper
EAzami_relevance: adds an unusual flower-colour state and transition-critical cytotype outside the best-sampled focal subsections
data_or_access: open PhytoKeys article and specimen evidence

title: Distinctive origin and evolution of endemic thistle of Korean volcanic island: Structural organization and phylogenetic relationships with complete chloroplast genome
sampling: one C. nipponicum accession with six-species Cirsium comparison
principal_inference: Recovered a maternal plastome placement closer to C. arvense and C. vulgare than to two Korean congeners and proposed a northern Eurasian route.
known_limit: single maternal genome and very small within-genus taxon sample; vulnerable to chloroplast capture
EAzami_relevance: important explicit example of why Korean plastome history must remain separate from the nuclear species tree

title: De Novo Genome Assembly and Phylogenetic Analysis of Cirsium nipponicum
markers_or_loci: Illumina plus Nanopore assembly; single-copy orthologs
sampling: one C. nipponicum genome compared with ten other plant genomes
principal_inference: Produced a 929.4 Mb draft nuclear genome with 0.7 Mb N50 and 95.1 percent BUSCO completeness and estimated divergence from Cynara.
known_limit: comparative tree contains no dense internal Cirsium sampling and therefore does not resolve Korean species relationships
EAzami_relevance: first reusable East Asian Cirsium nuclear reference for mapping and anthocyanin candidate discovery but not a regional species backbone
data_or_access: open Genes/PMC article and genome data

title: B-Chromosome and Cytomixis in Cirsium (Asteraceae)
principal_inference: Documented 0-2 B chromosomes in most sampled species plus cytomixis and meiotic abnormalities that can affect recombination and pollen fertility.
known_limit: no DNA species tree and geographically restricted
EAzami_relevance: expands the evidence that cytotype and reproductive anomalies must not be treated as incidental metadata

title: Hybridization may endanger the rare North Apennine endemic Cirsium bertolonii
markers_or_loci: AFLP; STRUCTURE; flow cytometry; chromosomes; morphometrics
sampling: 235 individuals across ten species and two hybrid combinations from 106 localities
principal_inference: Confirmed repeated hybridization and introgression involving C. bertolonii with C. acaulon and C. erisithales and corrected its chromosome number to 2n=34.
known_limit: regional dominant-marker study rather than a reusable species backbone
EAzami_relevance: strong empirical evidence that morphology and a nominal bifurcating tree can be decoupled by recurrent gene flow
data_or_access: open Springer article and online resources
